product_overview: The Student Dashboard is a user interface component within a learning management system aimed at providing students with real-time visibility into their course enrollments, progress, and learning activities. It integrates authenticated student data to display dynamic enrollment statistics, course details, and personalized next steps to enhance student engagement and learning outcomes.
core_goals: Provide students with up-to-date statistics on their enrolled, active, and completed courses.
Enable students to track their learning progress through clear visual indicators and progress bars.
Facilitate easy navigation for students to resume lessons and courses quickly.
Ensure data integrity by connecting UI components to real backend data via server actions.
Deliver performance with quick load times and handle empty or edge states gracefully.
key_features: Statistics Counter Widgets showing enrolled, active, and completed course counts with real data fetched using user-specific server actions.
Continue Learning section showcasing the next recommended lesson with course title, lesson title, thumbnail, and a direct link to continue.
My Courses Grid presenting all enrolled courses with detailed cards including thumbnails, instructor names, progress bars, and lesson completion counts.
Overall Progress circular indicator displaying the average completion percentage across active courses.
TypeScript migration refinement to ensure a clean single source of truth for dashboard code, improving maintainability and reliability.
user_flow_summary: Student logs into the system and navigates to /student-dashboard route.
The dashboard component receives the userId prop from StudentDashboardClient to Dashboard for data fetching.
Dashboard executes server action getStudentDashboardStats using the userId to retrieve enrollment and progress data.
Statistics counters update dynamically to reflect actual data from the database.
My Courses Grid populates with enrolled courses, each clickable to navigate to course details.
Continue Learning section displays the next recommended lesson; clicking continue navigates to that lesson page.
The overall progress indicator calculates and shows average completion percentage across all active courses.
Empty states (no enrollment) display an appropriate message encouraging course enrollment.
validation_criteria: Dashboard loads within 2 seconds under standard conditions.
Enrollment statistics counters accurately reflect the database records for the logged-in student.
Course cards in the My Courses Grid correctly display course thumbnails, titles, instructor names, and progress.
Continue Learning section correctly identifies and links to the next recommended lesson based on recent activity.
Navigation from dashboard cards and buttons routes correctly to course and lesson pages.
All TypeScript code is error-free and the migration removed duplicate JavaScript files, ensuring a single source of truth.
Empty states handled gracefully with appropriate messaging and no visual bugs.

features.name: Student Dashboard Data Integration
features.description: Connect Student Dashboard UI to real data by passing userId prop from StudentDashboardClient to Dashboard component. This enables the Dashboard to fetch actual enrollment statistics (enrolledCourses, activeCourses, completedCourses) using getStudentDashboardStats server action.

features.name: TypeScript Migration Cleanup
features.description: Remove duplicate JavaScript files (Dashboard.js, index.js, page.js) after migrating to TypeScript versions. The .tsx versions are now the single source of truth.
